section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes a single study (Study X) conducted in Hong Kong that evaluated the factor structure of the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) among 1,319 women and 1,084 men using confirmatory factor analysis. The study found that a modified two-dimensional BAS structure with 9 items had the best fit, with the General Body Appreciation factor showing good construct validity through significant correlations with BMI, self-esteem, and weight discrepancy.
